blocks.text: The large conference room will be closed for the rest of the week while the building replaces the carpet. The building expects to finish by Friday afternoon, but it has not committed to that. Meetings already booked in the large room have been moved to the small conference room, and the shared calendar reflects the change. The small room has a handset but no speakerphone, so if your meeting includes a call, please tell me by the end of today and I will borrow a unit from the building office.

Separately, the supply cabinet has been restocked with binders, index tabs, and printer toner. Please note what you take on the sheet inside the cabinet door, so that the next order reflects what we actually use.
